subject: How to determine tissue-specific DMR with methylkit

messages.author: b1c9560edff613e3
messages.subject: How to determine tissue-specific DMR with methylkit
parts:
Hello,

I am relatively new to methylkit. I have intalled, read the user guide, played around with some examples, and been reading your blog for more ideas on my project, which I think the tool particular suits well. I need help on how to proceed with an experiment. I have liver samples(3 controls, and 4 cases) and brain samples (2 cases, 3 controls). I should be grateful if you could help me with the steps I need to take in order to identify tissue-specific DMRs. 

Will really appreciate it. Thanks.

Henry


--

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] How to determine tissue-specific DMR with methylkit
parts:
Easiest thing would be to find DMRs in each tissue
And take the non-overlapping ones as tissue specific. There might be more complicated paths to take but this is a good start

Best
Altuna
